state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: mileage rate a business trip in a private electric car
state.step_intent: Find the mileage rate that applies to: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today?

passages.source: HB-26 §2 | Travel policy: private car use — Standard mileage rate | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-33
passages.text: Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 29 cents per km. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here.

passages.source: HB-33 §2 | Travel policy: private car use — Standard mileage rate | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-26
passages.text: Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 30 cents per km. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims.

passages.source: HB-36 §2 | Memo: mileage rate exceptions — Exception for electric vehicles | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: For electric vehicles, the mileage rate is 48 cents per km instead of the standard amount. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.source: HB-36 §3 | Memo: mileage rate exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to electric rental cars; they follow the standard mileage rate in HB-26 §2. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.source: HB-26 §1 | Travel policy: private car use — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-33
passages.text: This policy sets the mileage rate for all employees. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.
